sentences.text: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group closed its previous plan with record annual net profit of 1.583 trillion yen and guidance for a further rise to 1.7 trillion yen in the year to March 2027, with its 10% ROE target met and record EPS.

sentences.text: Japanese rate normalization is a direct earnings lever, as SMFG estimates each 25 basis point hike boosts annual earnings by about 100 billion yen.

The FY2026-2028 plan targets 13% ROTE and 2 trillion yen net income by FY3/29, en route to a medium-term 15% ROTE, supported by a portfolio shift toward less capital-intensive areas such as asset management and transaction banking.
Shareholder returns keep rising, with annual dividends of 157 yen per share at a 38.0% payout ratio and an approved buyback of up to 180 billion yen, with all shares to be cancelled.
Global wholesale ambitions rest on building capabilities for large-scale transactions by deepening collaboration with Jefferies.
